ORDINANCE XX OF 2009
CIVIL SERVANTS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2009
An Ordinance further to
amend the
Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
1st October, 2009]
No.2(I)/2009-Pub.,
dated 1-10-2009.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:---
Whereas it is expedient further to amend
the Civil Servants Act, 1973 (LXXI of 1973) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not
in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 9, Act LXXI of 1973

Whereas it is expedient further to amend

appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not
in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:--
2. Amendment of section 9, Act LXXI of 1973.--In
the Civil Servants Act, 1973 (LXXI of 1973) in section 9, for subsection (3)
the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(3) Promotion to the post in BS-20
and 21 or equivalent shall be made on the recommendations of a Selection Board
which shall consist of a Chairman and such other members as the Federal
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, appoint.".
